q: Some elders have given this mark of a good murshid: in whose company all whisperings and idle thoughts stop, and a person's mind becomes bound to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ. Look first and understand, then give your hand. Otherwise regret follows.
ru: Ba'z buzurgon ne achhe murshid ki yeh tameez batayi hai ke jis ki sohbat mein waswase aur fuzool khayalaat sab band ho jaayein, aur aadmi ka khayal Khuda aur Rasool ﷺ ke saath waabasta ho jaaye. Pehle dekho aur samjho, phir haath do. Warna pachtaawa hota hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 27:24

q: When I speak, keep looking into my eyes. The states that come out of my eyes come into your eyes too. That is why you should keep your eyes open and keep looking at the murshid.
ru: Jab main baat karun to meri aankhon mein dekhte raho. Meri aankhon se jo kaifiyaat nikalti hain, woh tumhari aankhon mein bhi aati hain. Isi liye aankhein khuli rakho aur murshid ko dekhte raho.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 28:07

q: If someone makes a mistake after giving bai'at, he should repent and say: Astaghfirullah al-'Azeem alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh. Repentance never goes to waste.
ru: Agar koi bai'at ke baad ghalti kare to tauba kare aur kahe: Astaghfirullah al-'Azeem alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh. Tauba kabhi zaaya nahin jaati.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 38:46

q: Neither a merely formal discipleship is of any use, nor a merely formal khilafat.
ru: Na sirf rasmi mureedi kisi kaam ki hai, na sirf rasmi khilafat.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 2, 12:58

q: That is why I keep saying: read this book. It teaches not only the murid, but the shaykh too.
ru: Isi liye main baar baar kehta hoon: yeh kitaab padho. Yeh sirf murid ko nahin, shaykh ko bhi sikhaati hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 3:33

q: A chilla means sitting for forty days, so that the worship done in them becomes a routine. In those forty days a special blessing descends, and for us it brings benefit both inwardly and outwardly.
ru: Chilla ka matlab hai chaalees din baithna, taaki un dinon mein jo ibaadat ki jaaye woh ma'mool ban jaaye. Un chaalees dinon mein ek khaas barakat naazil hoti hai, aur hamare liye us se zaahiri aur baatini dono faayda hota hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 2:52

q: Everyone goes to the masjid. Make the intention of i'tikaf for an hour or two: what harm is there? We should do it.
ru: Masjid mein sab jaate hain. Ghanta, do ghanta ke liye i'tikaf ki niyyat kar lo, to is mein kya buraai hai? Kar lena chahiye.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 17:52

q: In i'tikaf a person is turned wholly toward worship. His thought becomes fixed on one point. Complete attention is the soul of worship.
ru: I'tikaf mein aadmi hama-tan ibaadat ki taraf mutawajjeh rehta hai. Uska khayal ek nukte par qaayam ho jaata hai. Kaamil tawajjoh ibaadat ki jaan hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 18:18

q: A khatra is what comes and goes. When you make a firm intention about something, it is no longer a khatra; it becomes 'azm, a resolve. A khatra is forgiven; but the resolve is not forgiven.
ru: Khatra woh hai jo aata hai aur chala jaata hai. Jab aap kisi cheez ki pakki niyyat kar lete hain to woh khatra nahin rehta; woh 'azm ban jaata hai, yaani iraada. Khatra maaf hai; lekin 'azm maaf nahin.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 6, 1:57

q: For a few days, guard your gaze. When the heart is fixed on one point, the reality will come before you.
ru: Chand roz apni nazar ki hifaazat karo. Jab dil ek nukte par qaayam ho jaayega, haqeeqat saamne aa jaayegi.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 6, 12:55

q: O Master, we are waiting for Your grace. Take away these useless thoughts, and give us good thoughts.
ru: Ae Maalik, hum Tere fazl ke muntazir hain. Yeh bekaar khayalaat hum se door kar de, aur humein achhe khayalaat ata farma.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 7, 3:13

q: Whoever has no pir, his pir is Shaytan. The murid has his master's hand over him, so Shaytan cannot touch him.
ru: Jiska koi pir nahin, uska pir Shaitaan hai. Murid ke upar uske aaqa ka haath hota hai, isliye Shaitaan usko chhoo nahin sakta.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 42:08

q: Even if a sinless person repents, it is good for him. Repentance never goes to waste.
ru: Begunaah aadmi bhi tauba kare to uske liye achha hai. Tauba kabhi zaaya nahin jaati.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 38:58

q: All the Sufi ways are good, good from head to toe.
ru: Sufiya ke saare tareeqe achhe hain, sar se paaon tak achhe.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 55:48

q: Neither a merely formal discipleship is of any use, nor a merely formal khilafat.
ru: Na sirf rasmi mureedi kisi kaam ki hai, na sirf rasmi khilafat.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 2, 12:58

q: This book of Bahr-ul-Uloom, Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, is the timetable of those who count themselves poor in the way of Allah.
ru: Bahr-ul-Uloom ki yeh kitaab, Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, un logon ka time-table hai jo Allah ke raaste mein apne aap ko faqeer samajhte hain.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 6, 0:05

q: Taqwa is to eat less, sleep less, speak less, to weep over one's own wrongs, and to overlook the faults of others.
ru: Taqwa yeh hai ke kam khaana, kam sona, kam bolna, apni ghaltiyon par rona, aur doosron ke aib se nazar hata lena.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 1:38

q: To rely on Allah for your needs: this is called Tawakkul. Not working is not tawakkul.
ru: Apni zarooraton ke liye Allah par bharosa karna: isko Tawakkul kehte hain. Kaam na karna tawakkul nahin hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 6:04

q: Whatever work you have to do, do it by asking Allah. This is Istikhara.
ru: Jo bhi kaam karna ho, Allah se poochh kar karo. Yahi Istikhara hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 10:08

q: Sabr is to bear hardships and difficulties, even while the heart finds them hard.
ru: Sabr yeh hai ke takleefon aur mushkilon ko bardaasht karna, chaahe dil ko woh mushkil lagein.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 4, 5:48

q: All the murshids have the same goal: to keep the murid pure, and on the way of the Prophet ﷺ.
ru: Sab murshidon ka ek hi maqsad hai: murid ko paak rakhna, aur Huzoor ﷺ ke raaste par rakhna.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 56:18

q: For the murid, first there is Taqwa, then Tawakkul, then Sabr, then Tasleem and Raza. And after the nafs comes Fana: fana of the self, then in the Attributes, then in the Essence, and at last Baqa.
ru: Murid ke liye pehle Taqwa hai, phir Tawakkul, phir Sabr, phir Tasleem aur Raza. Aur nafs ke baad Fana aati hai: pehle apne aap ki fana, phir Sifaat mein, phir Zaat mein, aur aakhir mein Baqa.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 56:44

q: When a person wants to walk the path of Allah, he first regrets his past negligence and wrongdoing, and asks Allah's forgiveness.
ru: Jab aadmi Allah ke raaste par chalna chahta hai to woh pehle apni pichhli ghaflat aur ghaltiyon par sharminda hota hai, aur Allah se maafi maangta hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 2, 3:25

q: The one who frees you from bondage to everything else, his company is necessary. If he turns your thoughts towards Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, that is the real thing.
ru: Jo aapko har doosri cheez ki ghulaami se aazaad kar de, uski sohbat zaroori hai. Agar woh aapke khayal ko Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ki taraf mod de, to yahi asal cheez hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 27:46

q: There is only one straight path, and it is shorter than all the others. Whoever is on the straight path reaches the destination faster.
ru: Seedha raasta sirf ek hai, aur woh baaqi sab raaston se chhota hai. Jo seedhe raaste par hai woh manzil par jaldi pahunchta hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 4, 8:39

q: Look first and understand, then give your hand. Otherwise regret follows.
ru: Pehle dekho aur samjho, phir haath do. Warna pachtaawa hota hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 27:38

q: The purpose of Tasawwur-e-Shaykh is that the thought becomes fixed on one point.
ru: Shaykh ke tasawwur se maqsood khayal ka ek nukte par qaayam hona hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 9, 0:49

q: Do you know my tasawwur? I said: I don't know. He said: Do this. Hold my picture in your mind. Look at me in the picture. That's it. I began from there, and within a few days my eyes opened.
ru: Mera tasawwur jaante ho? Maine kaha: nahin jaanta. Farmaya: yeh karo. Meri tasveer apne zehan mein rakho. Tasveer mein mujhe dekho. Bas. Maine wahin se shuru kiya, aur kuch hi din mein meri aankhein khul gayin.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 2, 24:07

q: Do not take these as mere imaginings; they are bab-e-futuh, the door of opening. They make one progress, and show wondrous sights.
ru: Nire khayaalaat mat samjho. Yeh bab-e-futuh hain, yaani kholne ka darwaaza. Yeh taraqqi karaate hain, aur ajeeb-o-ghareeb tamaashe dikhaate hain.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 9, 24:05

q: Becoming aware of people's passing thoughts, and seeing faraway things: these are all matters of a low degree.
ru: Logon ke khatraat se waaqif ho jaana, aur door door ki cheezein dekhna, yeh sab to adna darje ki baatein hain.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 9, 9:42

q: Present your kashf to the Qur'an and Hadith. If it agrees, act on it; if it does not, leave it.
ru: Apne kashf ko Qur'an aur Hadith par pesh karo. Agar mutaabiq ho to amal karo; na ho to chhod do.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 30:36

q: First: bring the fard prayers. Did you pray? Yes, I did. Bring your prayers. So many prayers. Put them on the scale. What is the weight? Not yet enough for Paradise.
ru: Pehle: farz namazein laao. Namaz padhi? Haan, padhi. Apni namazein laao. Itni namazein. Meezaan par rakho. Wazan kitna hai? Abhi Jannat ke liye kaafi nahin.
label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 6:17

q: You will be with the one you love. The Prophet ﷺ said this.
ru: Tum usi ke saath hoge jis se tum mohabbat karte ho. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh farmaya.
label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 7:33

q: Islam is related to Allah, and faith to the Prophet ﷺ. What is Islam? La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah. And what is faith? More than my own life, the Prophet ﷺ is dear to me.
ru: Islam ka ta'alluq Allah se hai, aur imaan ka Huzoor ﷺ se. Islam kya hai? La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasulullah. Aur imaan kya hai? Apni jaan se zyaada Huzoor ﷺ mujhe pyaare hain.
label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:34

q: My life is a sacrifice for the Prophet ﷺ. My children, my family, my wealth, all of it a sacrifice for the Prophet ﷺ. This is faith.
ru: Meri jaan Huzoor ﷺ par qurbaan. Mere bachche, mera khaandaan, mera maal, sab Huzoor ﷺ par qurbaan. Yahi imaan hai.
label: Dars on the soul, the scale and the malida, 8:52

q: Those who become murids: the Hand of Allah is over their hand. See, this is a very great thing, and yet people do not want to give bai'at.
ru: Jo murid ho rahe hain, unke haath par Allah ka haath hai. Dekhiye, bahut badi baat hai, aur bai'at ko hi nahin karna chahte hain log.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 1:25

q: Bai'at is a covenant. It was a custom of the Arabs that when an agreement was made, they struck hand upon hand. In every kingdom an oath of loyalty is taken; in the same way, bai'at is taken to confirm something important.
ru: Bai'at ek mu'ahida hai. Arabon ki ek aadat yeh hai ke koi mu'ahida kiya jaata hai to haath par haath maarte hain. Tamaam saltanaton mein half-e-wafadari liya jaata hai; isi tarah kisi aham baat ki taakeed par bai'at ki jaati hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 3:26

q: In short, taking a pledge on something important is called bai'at.
ru: Gharz ke kisi aham cheez par ahad lene ka naam bai'at hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 6:18

q: From the 'Arsh, from Allah, a rope hangs down to the earth, and it is in the blessed hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The moment one becomes a murid, a connection with the 'Arsh comes into being.
ru: Arsh se, Allah ke paas se, ek rassi zameen tak latakti rehti hai, aur woh Rasoolullah ﷺ ke dast-e-mubarak mein hoti hai. Murid hote hi ta'alluq Arsh se paida ho jaata hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 16:43

q: The source of Sufism, or the knowledge of ladunni, is the Hadith and the Qur'an.
ru: Tasawwuf, ya ilm-e-ladunni, ka sarchashma Hadith aur Qur'an hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 54:31

q: Shariat is to pray, to fast, to perform Hajj, to pay Zakat. All of this is Shariat. And what is Tariqat? To build a connection with Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.
ru: Shariat yeh hai: namaz padhna, roza rakhna, Hajj karna, Zakat dena. Yeh sab Shariat hai. Aur Tariqat kya hai? Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ se ta'alluq banaana.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 2, 9:05

q: The things of the soul cannot be seen; we come to know them through knowledge.
ru: Rooh ki cheezein dikhaayi nahin deti; hum inko ilm ke zariye jaante hain.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 2, 10:23

q: All the Sufi ways are good, good from head to toe. But along with that, in one the eyes are beautiful, in another the smile, in another the speech.
ru: Sufiya ke saare tareeqe achhe hain, sar se paaon tak achhe. Lekin iske saath, kisi mein aankhein khoobsurat hain, kisi mein muskuraahat, kisi mein baat-cheet.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 55:48

q: Ad-du'a mukhkh al-'ibadah: du'a is the core of worship. The worship we do is completed by du'a.
ru: Ad-du'a mukhkh al-'ibadah: dua ibaadat ka maghz hai. Jo ibaadat hum karte hain woh dua se mukammal hoti hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 7, 7:49

q: Your work is only to pray. Allah's work is to give. I am the one who prays; Allah is the One who gives.
ru: Tumhara kaam sirf dua karna hai. Dena Allah ka kaam hai. Main dua karne wala hoon; dene wala Allah hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 51:17

q: Then, standing right there, he said: Ya Allah, You give Maryam fruit out of season. Now have mercy on me, be generous to me: give me a child out of season.
ru: Phir wahin khade rah kar bole: Ya Allah, Tu Maryam ko be-mausam ke mewe deta hai. Ab mujh par raham farma, karam farma: mujhe be-mausam ki aulaad de.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 34:29

q: The house of Allah is for everyone. But whomever Allah calls His wali, His friend, and is kind to: that is his honour, his good fortune.
ru: Allah ka ghar to sab ke liye hai, magar Allah jisko wali bole, dost bole, us par meherbaan ho jaaye, to woh uski tauqeer hai, uski khush-naseebi hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 38:33

q: The court of the awliya of Allah is the place where Allah accepts du'as. Keep this in mind.
ru: Auliya Allah ki baargaah Allah Ta'ala ke duaayein qabool karne ka maqaam hai. Iska khayal rahe.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 8, 40:09

q: Think carefully: two and two make four. Arithmetic is such certain knowledge that hardly any other is so certain. Yet from the first class to the tenth it is learned from teachers, and only then does one master it.
ru: Zara ghaur karo: do aur do chaar hote hain. Hisaab aisa yaqeeni ilm hai ke bamushkil koi doosra ilm aisa yaqeeni o qat'i ho sakta hai. Magar pehli jamaat se le kar daswein jamaat tak hisaab ki ta'leem asaatiza se haasil ki jaati hai, tab kahin us mein mahaarat haasil hoti hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 7:30

q: Think: if in an important court case a new lawyer were engaged every day, the case could not be pursued properly, nor could success be hoped for.
ru: Zara ghaur karo ke kisi aham muqadme mein har roz ek wakeel badla jaaye to na pairwi barabar ho sakti hai, na kaamyaabi ki tawaqqo hai.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 10:44

q: In the same way, a person of ordinary thoughts and weak faith who sits in the company of a perfected one: his doubtful and harmful thoughts grow weaker and weaker.
ru: Isi tarah, maamooli khayalaat aur kamzor imaan wala aadmi jab kisi kaamil ki sohbat mein baithta hai to uske shak wale aur nuqsaandeh khayalaat kamzor se kamzor hote jaate hain.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 33:31

q: There is an old saying: 'Whoever has no pir, his pir is Shaytan.' The murid has his master's hand over him, so Shaytan cannot touch him.
ru: Ek purani kahaawat hai: 'Jiska koi pir nahin, uska pir Shaitaan hai.' Murid ke upar uske aaqa ka haath hota hai, isliye Shaitaan usko chhoo nahin sakta.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 1, 42:08

q: Who are these murids? Spiritual children. In sha Allah, the murids will be joined with their master; they will rise with him.
ru: Yeh murideen kaun hain? Roohani aulaad. In shaa Allah, murideen apne aaqa ke saath milaaye jaayenge; unke saath uthaaye jaayenge.
label: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at, recording 2, 9:28

q: When we want to do the dhikr of the Kalima, La ilaha illa Allah, we first read Fa'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allah: know that there is no god but Allah.
ru: Jab hum Kalime ka zikr, La ilaha illa Allah, karna chahte hain to pehle Fa'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allah padhte hain: jaan lo ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahin.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 3, 19:59

q: Through this pact of yaad-faramosh, not only does one get help toward constant presence; one also has to admit one's own mistake, and your work becomes lillah, fillah.
ru: Is yaad-faramosh ke mu'ahide se na sirf dawaam-e-huzoor ko madad milti hai, balke apni ghalati ka i'tiraaf karna padta hai. Tumhara kaam lillah fillah ho jaata hai.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 7, 11:28

q: Your work is only to recite. To give it effect, to complete it, is the work of Allah. You do your work.
ru: Tumhara kaam sirf padhna hai. Usko asar dena, usko poora karna, Allah ka kaam hai. Tum apna kaam karo.
label: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, part 1, 50:49
